name: tailwind-image-accordion
title: Tailwind Image Accordion
description: Three tall portrait photos share a row on a dark page; the card under the pointer grows to most of the width and the others shrink behind a pale blur. The open card lifts its name and job title into view.
use: A team or people section wants large portraits that open under the cursor without a separate page.
avoid: The expanding row is desktop only; below the md breakpoint the cards just stack and the effect is gone.
a11y: Focus expands a card like hover does and adds an indigo ring, but motion ignores reduced-motion and each card links to a dead #. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: Three rounded portrait photos in a row: a pug on a yellow backdrop, a man against black and a man against pale blue. Neighbours of the hovered card become narrow strips washed by a soft white veil.
behaves: Hovering or keyboard-focusing a card takes it to about four fifths of the row and squeezes the other two into blurred slivers. The name rises into the open card first, then the role, and both ease back out when the pointer leaves.
customise: No props: the three people, their roles and photo links are fixed in the items array in the file, and the open width and timings are utility classes.
weight: light: Three photos and pure CSS width and opacity transitions.
